name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Skeleton: a light screentone (tone-10) that flickers in steps instead of pulsing in opacity, no heavy frame. Shapes: text, avatar, panel, block. SkeletonCard composes a card placeholder.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/skeleton". It wraps your own components/ui/skeleton, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A light screentone that flickers while content loads.

props.name: SkeletonCard
